# pages

> Minimal static Page publishing. One Go command uploads one HTML file or one
> zip directory Page and returns where it lives. The Public Root also serves a
> generated Page Index and Page Record for browsing the current Pages.
>
> Link set for the pages command contract at the merge of `2efb44a`. Compare
> `pages --version` before relying on a specific message or flag.

## Start here

- [Agent Skill](skills/pages/SKILL.md): The stable bootstrap for an agent. It
  runs `pages skill`, which prints the version-matched instructions for the
  installed CLI.
- [Product overview](README.md): The three product actions, what pages keeps,
  and what it does not.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): One pass from install to a live
  Page, including the static host.
- [Publishing](docs/publishing.md): The Publish contract, both modes, partial
  effects, and limits.

## Tasks

- [Publish one Page](docs/publishing.md#two-ways-to-publish): Local and remote
  Publish, Destination selection, and the printed result.
- [Browse current Pages](docs/catalog.md): The Page Index, the Published Time
  of each Page, and the Page Record.
- [Configure Publish](docs/configuration.md): Tokens file, publish config
  file, flags, and environment variables.
- [Run the service](docs/deployment.md): systemd, Docker, and the reference
  Caddy configuration, including the Content Security Policy.

## Contracts

- [Command contract](design/cli.md): The single authoritative pages command
  contract. Command grammar, Destination syntax, input precedence, output,
  and exit codes. Other documents link here and do not copy its tables.
- [Architecture](design/architecture.md): The write path, the identity
  boundary, and atomic replacement.
- [Page Index design](design/catalog.md): Scanning, rendering, Published Time,
  the Page Record, refresh, and replacement.

## Checks and recovery

- [Identity and Tokens](docs/publishing.md#default-and-named-identity): Which
  mode needs a Token, how a Token selects an Identity, and what each usage
  error tells you to do next.
- [Reader guarantees](docs/publishing.md#reader-guarantees): What a reader
  sees during a swap, and what a repeat Publish means.
- [Partial effects](docs/publishing.md#partial-effects): Failure after the
  Page is in place, and how to check before publishing again.
- [Testing](design/testing.md): The unit test strategy and the verification
  gate.

## Limits

- [Limits](docs/publishing.md#limits): No archive, revision, or history; no
  standard input; Page scripts are the host's responsibility.
